What was taken away, and what each costs

  1. Navy table headings → quiet grey words over a line. Also the pillars list heading. The navy now belongs to the navigation alone.
  2. One frame instead of three. The tables lose their rounded boxes and the grey stripe on every other row; rows are separated by a hairline. The pillar list loses its card per pillar; the open one is marked by a gold edge.
  3. Columns that said the same thing on every row are gone. # is gone. Dir. moves into the target (≥ 90%). Compiled goes into the heading (Target · latest) when every row is the same — a row that differs would bring the column back. Collabs. is hidden when nobody is named on any tactic, and comes back the moment one is. Cost: the row numbers were how people said "tactic 3" in a meeting.
  4. Only the tactic is bold. The outcome reads as normal text.
  5. Nothing said twice. The code (MB01) is shown once, in the heading, not above every name in the list. "Capability" is a quiet word beside the name, not a pill. The counts beside "Key measures" and "Tactics" are gone. Cost: to find a pillar by its code you now read the heading, not the list.
  6. Quarters as words. Q2–Q3 instead of four circles. Cost: the circles showed which quarter is already past; the words don't.

Not touched

The navigation, the tab row, the section switch and the Edit button stay exactly as they are — you asked for those to stay. Editing mode is not drawn yet; if this direction is right I'll draw it next, because the edit boxes need the same treatment.

Your call

Is this the direction? Tell me anything to put back (the row numbers and the past-quarter marker are the two I'd watch). Then I'll draw editing mode and a supporting function's page in the same way before anything is built.
